lines: {target}? Sound travels farther than sense. I would count arrows and find cover.
If anyone heads for Deep Dark, tell them: Walk soft and do not open every chest. I will be at the fletching table.
Sculk hears what pride forgets. I will remember that when I count arrows.
Deep Dark is no small story. Range helps only if you see trouble first.
I will remember Deep Dark as darkness that listens back. I will keep dry string and straight arrows ready.
{target}? Stone teeth hang above and wait below. I would count arrows and find cover.
If anyone heads for Dripstone Caves, tell them: Look up as often as you look down. I will be at the fletching table.
Pointed stone makes every stumble serious. I will remember that when I count arrows.
Dripstone Caves is no small story. Range helps only if you see trouble first.
I will remember Dripstone Caves as a cave that bites from both directions. I will keep dry string and straight arrows ready.
{target}? Pretty caves still have long drops. I would count arrows and find cover.
If anyone heads for Lush Caves, tell them: Watch the vines and the holes between them. I will be at the fletching table.
Glow berries light paths that may not be safe. I will remember that when I count arrows.
Lush Caves is no small story. Range helps only if you see trouble first.
I will remember Lush Caves as a cave trying very hard to look harmless. I will keep dry string and straight arrows ready.
